name: anneal
description: anneal: enforced SDLC gates for Claude Code. Install anneal@anneal, and anneal-cockpit@anneal for the Claude Code band and pane.

plugins.name: anneal
plugins.description: Turns prose SDLC gates into enforced checks: skills, a deterministic CLI behind hooks, and calibrated judgement calls.

plugins.name: anneal-cockpit
plugins.description: The cockpit mod for Claude Code: a band and an /anneal pane showing anneal's state. Kept apart from anneal because desktop chats turn off any plugin that ships a mod.
